_comment: AUTHORITATIVE registry of deployed Spartan1 addresses, keyed by chain id.
Unlike relays.json (convenience, not authority), a value here is load-bearing: a wrong
address produces signatures that can never settle. So it is verified, not trusted.
VERIFICATION (a consumer MUST do this before trusting a value): confirm that code exists
at the address on the given chain (eth_getCode != 0x) AND that it is the audited Spartan1
bytecode / a verified source match. Only then sign against it.
Every value is null until the contract is deployed and the vector is re-frozen:
scripts/refreeze_spender.py writes the address here as part of the deploy-day flow, and the
coherence gate (scripts/check_coherence.py) asserts every non-null value equals the frozen
vector spender. null means NOT DEPLOYED - the SDK and dApp must refuse it as loudly as the
placeholder sentinel (a null/placeholder spender is unsettleable).
